edges.reason: purchaseTokens uses msg.sender for getInvested() and invested_[msg.sender] instead of the _customerAddress argument, letting the caller manipulate investment state
isActivated modifier gates purchaseTokens on block.timestamp versus ACTIVATION_TIME
block.timestamp (now) is compared against ACTIVATION_TIME to enable the contract
withdraw performs the external erc20.transfer payout to the caller
external token transfer can re-enter the contract and interact with payoutsTo_ accounting
withdraw increases payoutsTo_ before paying out
withdraw zeroes referralBalance_ for the caller
exit() calls sell() on the caller's balance
exit() calls withdraw() afterwards
buy() calls checkAndTransferMDX() to pull tokens
buy() calls purchaseTokens() to mint
distribute() calls checkAndTransferMDX() to pull the donation
distribute increases profitPerShare_ by (_amount * magnitude) / tokenSupply_
distribute divides by tokenSupply_, which may be zero
checkAndTransferMDX performs the external erc20.transferFrom call
external token transferFrom may re-enter before internal accounting completes
purchaseTokens adds _amountOfTokens to tokenSupply_
purchaseTokens recomputes profitPerShare_ with dividends * magnitude / tokenSupply_
purchaseTokens updates payoutsTo_ for the customer
purchaseTokens credits referralBalance_ for maintenance and referrer
purchaseTokens credits tokenBalanceLedger_ of the customer
purchaseTokens mixes raw int256/uint256 arithmetic on _fee and _updatedPayouts without SafeMath
sell subtracts _amountOfTokens from tokenSupply_

transfer moves balances between tokenBalanceLedger_ entries

purchaseTokens calls getInvested() which reads invested_[msg.sender]

sell derives _customerAddress directly from msg.sender

Input amount belongs to buy and is forwarded to checkAndTransferMDX/purchaseTokens
Token amount belongs to sell and is validated against the caller balance
Recipient address belongs to transfer balance movement
Token amount belongs to transfer fee and balance accounting
Deposit amount belongs to the purchaseTokens minting logic
Referrer address controls referralBalance_ credit inside purchaseTokens
Customer address receives minted balances inside purchaseTokens
Caller-derived local used only for the withdraw payout
Computed payout local used only inside withdraw
Balance read used only to drive the sell call inside exit
Minted amount local used only inside purchaseTokens
